name: Prevent concurrent balance modification race conditions
title: SC-05-02-01 Prevent concurrent balance modification race conditions
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given two PostgreSQL accrual transactions for the same unit and period
When both attempt to commit concurrently
Then exactly one liability is committed
And the conflicting transaction is a clean no-op with no duplicate balance
